topic: Analyzing Brazil data trends and gaps
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on reviewing a year of historical advertising data for Brazil, specifically addressing perceived dips and gaps in the trend line (e.g., Campinas). Concerns were raised about the data appearing to start later than expected (around April-May) and whether the decline was accurate.

It was determined that the apparent dip in Campinas' data might be due to location data being migrated, resulting in a mix of old 2023 data and new facility IDs from the future. The system behavior confirmed that new data for existing locations is not overwriting previous records, but rather creating new entries.

The goal was clarified: ensuring that currently active facilities have a full year's worth of data, while acknowledging that it is acceptable if some older facilities (from 2023) are no longer tracked.
decisions: The apparent dip in Campinas' trend line is likely due to location migration and new facility IDs being added, not necessarily a genuine drop in performance.
The data collection process should prioritize ensuring currently active facilities have a full year of historical data.
action_items: [me] will investigate the cause of the data gaps and correct the reporting accordingly.
